verdict.rationale: Onboarding speed is a fair question for a business banking platform like Wise Business, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents how long business account opening, verification or KYB takes, or any claim of a roughly one-week onboarding. The account-creation items (wise-docs-1, wise-docs-5) describe partners offering accounts via API and say nothing about a founder's onboarding timeline.

support.subject: As a founder, I can fully onboard onto a new banking platform in about a week instead of months
